description: Publishes rows explicitly coded A from Florida's official quarterly corporate data, retaining a privacy-minimized all-status source snapshot plus active organization identity, filing profile, reported principal address, temporal evidence, provenance, and explicit non-site semantics.
redirect_policy: Not applicable to SFTP. Reject any host, port, username, path, or host key outside the pinned public-source contract.
retry: Retry transient SFTP transport failures with bounded exponential backoff and resume from the verified partial byte offset. Do not retry host-key mismatch, authentication failure, remote-path drift, archive-size violation, invalid ZIP structure, fixed-width drift, duplicate identity, or quality-gate failure.
checkpoint: Record remote size and modified time before download; resume only against identical metadata. Download to run-scoped temporary storage, hash the archive, stream every filing member, retain only approved selected fields, then delete the unminimized archive. Recheck remote metadata before publication. A complete selected-field staged snapshot can be independently replayed without reacquisition. current.json changes only after verification and atomic release publication.
idempotency: Remote modified time and size plus archive SHA-256 and the ordered privacy-minimized source SHA-256 identify a source release; the Florida corporate document number creates one stable provisional organization candidate.
cancellation: Abort SFTP and local streams cooperatively, delete the unminimized partial or complete archive, retain only privacy-minimized unpublished staging for diagnosis, and do not change current.json.
retention_profile: Retain immutable internal selected-field source snapshots and approved normalized releases; never retain the unminimized source archive in a published release.
